title: Leiter/-in Innovation
descriptionHtml:
Sion (und Homeoffice) | 80-100%

Diesen Beitrag können Sie leisten

  • Innovationspotenzial innerhalb des Kommandos Militärpolizei sowie an den Schnittstellen zu Partnerorganisationen identifizieren, bewerten und umsetzen
  • Innovative Ansätze und Zukunftskonzepte gemeinsam mit internen Partnern, sowie nationalen und internationalen Sicherheitsakteuren entwickeln und etablieren
  • Innovationsprojekte in den Bereichen Digitalisierung, künstliche Intelligenz, Cyber Security, Datenanalyse, Smart Policing, Drohnen- und Sensorsysteme sowie moderne Einsatzunterstützung konzipieren und steuern
  • Neue Technologien, Methoden und Organisationsmodelle analysieren, testen und benchmarken – insbesondere im Vergleich mit zivilen Polizeikorps, internationalen Sicherheitsbehörden, Streitkräften und Forschungsinstitutionen
  • Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei der Einführung innovativer Prozesse, digitaler Lösungen und agiler Arbeitsmethoden beraten, begleiten und befähigen
  • Eine nachhaltige Innovationskultur fördern, Verbesserungsvorschläge der Mitarbeitenden aktiv aufnehmen und die Militärpolizei als lernende und zukunftsorientierte Organisation weiterentwickeln

Das macht Sie einzigartig

  • Hochschulabschluss (Master) mit relevanter Berufserfahrung
  • Vertiefte Kenntnisse militärischer und polizeilicher Führungs-, Einsatz- und Sicherheitsprozesse auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit sicherheitsrelevanten Technologien, digitalen Plattformen, Datenmanagement, Cyber-Themen oder organisationsübergreifender Transformation
  • Erfahrung in Innovationsmanagement, Projektleitung, Strategieentwicklung, Change Management und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
  • Analytische, konzeptionelle und kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit hoher Umsetzungsstärke
  • Gute aktive Kenntnisse mindestens einer zweiten Amtssprache sowie idealerweise passive Kenntnisse einer dritten Amtssprache

Auf den Punkt gebracht

Treiben Sie die Innovation der Militärpolizei von morgen aktiv voran! Als Leiter/-in Innovation gestalten Sie mit strategischem Weitblick, technologischer Kompetenz und hoher Umsetzungskraft die Zukunft der Militärpolizei. Sie entwickeln zukunftsweisende Konzepte, fördern digitale und operative Transformationen und schaffen intelligente Lösungen für eine moderne, resiliente und vernetzte Sicherheitsorganisation. Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, Einsatz, Führung und Sicherheitspolitik und prägen aktiv die Weiterentwicklung der Polizeiarbeit im Zeitalter von Digitalisierung, Cyber-Bedrohungen und gesellschaftlichem Wandel.

Das bieten wir

  • Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.
  • Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.
  • Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.

Alle Benefits

Das Kommando Operationen (Kdo Op) ist für alle militärischen Operationen und Einsätze der Schweizer Armee verantwortlich. Zum Kdo Op gehören u. a. die Luftwaffe, das Heer, die vier Territorialdivisionen, das Kompetenzzentrum SWISSINT, das Kommando Spezialkräfte sowie die Militärpolizei. Rund 40 % der ca. 2'500 Mitarbeitenden sind zivil angestellt – von Ingenieur/-innen über Luftfahrzeugmechaniker/-innen bis hin zu Analyst/-innen. Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

Zusätzliche Informationen

Lernen Sie Ihren Arbeitgeber kennen: Sie finden weitere Informationen zur Militärpolizei unter Militärpolizei. Eine Anstellung bei der Schweizer Armee macht Sinn und bringt viele Vorteile mit sich. Überzeugen Sie sich auf armee.ch/vorteile.

Fragen zur Stelle

Stefan Aegerter Stellvertreter Kommandant / Chef Einsatz- und Laufbahnsteuerung / Laufbahnplanung +41 58 46 06795

title: Securities Services - Onboarding Product Development - Vice President
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

About J.P. Morgan Corporate & Investment Bank: Join J.P. Morgan, a global leader in financial services, renowned for delivering innovative solutions and exceptional service to clients worldwide. With a strong presence in the marketplace and a commitment to excellence, we offer outstanding career opportunities within one of the most respected financial institutions.

Securities Services: J.P. Morgan Securities Services, a division of the Corporate & Investment Bank (CIB), is a global industry leader managing $35.8 trillion in assets under custody, providing cutting-edge global custody, fund accounting, middle office services, and more to the world's largest institutional investors and asset managers.

Role Overview

As a Vice President – Product Delivery Manager, you will drive the definition and delivery of the strategic roadmap for end-to-end onboarding. This role offers the unique opportunity to bring scale to an internal application, delivering innovative solutions that improve business outcomes, client experience, operational efficiency, and control standards.

You will lead the design and execution of the AI & Data Strategy for Securities Services Onboarding, establishing a well-governed data foundation to streamline how data requirements, validations, changes, and downstream impacts are captured, assessed, and implemented. Partnering closely with Product, Technology, Operations, and Controls, you will ensure data is consistent, reusable, traceable, and fit for purpose, while applying AI/ML-enabled approaches to enhance insights, efficiency, and risk management.

Job Responsibilities

  • Engage senior stakeholders to communicate business needs, data priorities, key risks, and strategic objectives; clearly articulate trade-offs and recommendations.
  • Define and deliver the strategic vision and roadmap for end-to-end onboarding platforms and data capabilities, partnering with firmwide and Securities Services teams to drive business outcomes, client experience, efficiency, and controls.
  • Own the product, process, and data end-to-end, including data definitions, lineage, quality, access, and change control; evaluate trade-offs and downstream impacts across products, processes, and reporting.
  • Establish a standardized framework for intake, prioritization, documentation, and delivery of product and data requirements/changes across onboarding platforms, leveraging AI/ML where appropriate. Apply data, AI/ML, and analytics to solve problems, track and communicate progress, and inform decision-making across large and complex datasets.
  • Engage across management, operations, and delivery teams to review, document, and communicate objectives, program needs, progress updates, and risks; escalate as needed.
  • Maintain requirements traceability to business objectives, ensuring scope and requirements remain aligned to the business case.
  • Lead the delivery lifecycle—business requirements, functional requirements review, build/implementation oversight, UAT, and production rollout—ensuring delivery is on time, on budget, and aligned to priorities.
  • Lead impact analysis for changes (process, operational, regulatory/control, and technology), ensuring risks are identified early and escalated appropriately.
  • Partner with Operations to define scalable operating processes and readiness to support the product. Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering an inclusive, collaborative culture.
  • Identify, manage, and mitigate risks/issues, balancing speed-to-market with control and operational risk standards.
  • Organize the team for sustained delivery, aligning roles and responsibilities to individuals' strengths and capabilities. Set clear goals and expectations, and grow talent through coaching, delegation, empowerment, and training opportunities

Required Qualifications, Capabilities & Skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Financial Services across Data-Driven Product Development, Business Transformation, and/or Onboarding, with strong business analysis and change management skills.
  • Expertise in analyzing business problems to define detailed requirements and translate them into user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria to support technology delivery and user adoption.
  • Self-starter mindset, with demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problem spaces and drive execution with minimal oversight.
  • Strong project/program management capability, delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end.
  • Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, aligning senior partners across Product, Technology, Operations, and Controls, including across regions and time zones.
  • Hands-on knowledge of data architecture, including data modelling, data lineage, and data quality.
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms and data governance models.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce clear documentation and translate complex concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • Highly organized, with strong prioritization and delivery discipline.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities & Skills

  • Experience with AI/ML solutions to drive change and governance of data models is preferred.

Why Join Us?

This is a rare opportunity to be at the cutting edge of a critical area within J.P. Morgan, where you can leverage your Product Delivery, Data and AI expertise to build transformative applications from the ground up. If you are an energetic self-starter with a passion for innovation and excellence, we invite you to join our dynamic team in Mumbai and make a significant impact on the future of Onboarding within Securities Services.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Tech Lead - AI
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

This is the pod’s most critical hire. You set the technical direction for every piece of AI work at Kissht - architecture, integration patterns, evaluation infrastructure, and the call between vendor APIs and self-hosted models. When someone asks “how do we do AI engineering here?”, the answer is yours to give.


Responsibilities - building and delivery

  • AI platform architecture: LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, context engineering, evaluation harnesses, observability.
  • Build-vs-buy technical calls, in partnership with other stakeholders.
  • Engineering standards for AI work across Kissht: how we prompt, evaluate, monitor, and iterate.
  • Technical vendor evaluations: API testing, latency and accuracy benchmarks, integration complexity, red-flag surfacing.
  • Mentoring the two SDE-2 Builders and the Data Engineer. You set the quality bar.


What success looks like - first 90 days

  • The pod’s AI architecture is documented, reviewed, and being followed in active builds.
  • The evaluation harness used by the pod is operational and used in at least one live vendor eval.
  • The two SDEs are productive and unblocked technically.


What success looks like - first 180 days

  • One in-house AI orchestration layer is in production, owned by the pod, and integrated with at least two Kissht systems.
  • The build-vs-buy decision flow has been used on at least three vendor decisions, with documented rationale.
  • AI engineering standards are visible to non-pod engineers and at least one team outside the pod has adopted them.


Must-haves

  • 7–8 years of backend engineering experience. At least 2 years building LLM-based products in production.
  • Deep familiarity with at least one production-grade LLM ecosystem and its orchestration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with RAG architecture, vector databases, evaluation pipelines, and context engineering.
  • Strong systems thinking: prompt → data pipeline → model → integration → monitoring, end to end.
  • Strong Python. Comfortable reading and writing production-grade backend code.
  • Bias for action. You decide and move with incomplete information, rather than waiting for full certainty.
  • Proof of building. GitHub repos with real code are required. Side projects, hackathon work, or open-source contributions count. A polished LinkedIn alone is not enough.


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in financial services integrations, real-time voice AI, or document intelligence.
  • Experience leading a small team of 3–4 engineers.
  • Cloud architecture experience on AWS.
  • Snowflake experience or comfort designing on top of a cloud data warehouse.


Why we are hiring an AI Pod

AI is changing how lending works. The opportunities for Kissht sit across five capability areas:

  • Document intelligence across Indian languages
  • Voice AI in Indian languages

descriptionHtml:
About The Company

Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Unified Collaboration Product Manager with 15+ years in product management, telecom, or enterprise collaboration domains. The role will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of unified collaboration solutions encompassing UCaaS, cloud telephony and video conferencing.

The ideal candidate combines deep domain expertise, strong business insights, and technical understanding to drive innovative, scalable, and customer-centric solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle for unified collaboration solutions.
  • Align product strategy with business goals, market trends, and customer needs.
  • Identify emerging technologies (AI, automation, cloud communications) and integrate into offerings.

Market & Customer Insights

  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery.
  • Build deep understanding of enterprise collaboration needs across industries.
  • Translate insights into high-impact product features and differentiation.

Product Development & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch and scaling.
  • Work closely with engineering, UX, architecture, and operations teams to deliver solutions.
  • Define product requirements, user stories, and success metrics (KPIs).

Unified Collaboration Ecosystem

  • Oversee products covering:
    • Enterprise & cloud voice telephony (VoIP, SIP, PBX)
    • Video conferencing & meetings platforms
    • Messaging and team collaboration tools
    • Ecosystem(tools/EMS/NMS/Automation tools/API Integrations) supporting Services
    • Integration with enterprise tools (CRM, ITSM, APIs)
  • Ensure interoperability across platforms and vendors.
  • Law of the land & its regulations
Go-to-Market & Business Growth

  • Define pricing, service offering and positioning strategies.
  • Partner with sales, marketing, and channel teams for successful launches.
  • Drive revenue growth, adoption, and customer retention.

Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with senior leadership, partners, and vendors.
  • Manage cross-functional stakeholders across technology, delivery and operations.
  • Present roadmap, progress, and performance metrics to executives.

Performance & Analytics

  • Establish KPIs and monitor product performance.
  • Use data-driven insights to optimize features, UX, and monetization.
  • Drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in Product Management, Telecom, UCaaS, or Enterprise Collaboration.
  • Proven track record of launching and scaling unified communication or SaaS products.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Microsoft Teams Cloud Telephony (Teams DR/ Team OC/PBX Solutioning options)
    • Collaboration ecosystems (Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Cisco Webex, etc.)
  • Excellent stakeholder management and leadership skills.
  • Experience working with Global Service Integrators & Global Managed Service Providers.
Preferred Skills

  • Experience in AI-driven collaboration (chatbots, transcription, analytics).
  • Knowledge of market offering vs positioning for MS Cloud Telephony options.
  • Exposure to security, compliance, and enterprise-grade architecture.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Business/Technology preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Customer-Centric Mindset
  • Strong Communication & Influencing Skills
  • Analytical & Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Execution Excellence
  • Leadership & Team Collaboration

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and customer satisfaction (NPS)
  • Revenue growth and market share
  • Time-to-market and delivery efficiency
  • Platform scalability and reliability
  • Innovation and feature differentiation

title: Head of Product
descriptionHtml:
About Flexmoney

Flexmoney’s mission is to “Re-imagine Consumer Credit” for the mobile-first digital

consumer. Our omni-channel embedded finance affordability platform enables merchants,

brands and partners to seamlessly embed contextual affordability options across all customer

touchpoints and sales channels, so as to drive higher conversion and increase customer

satisfaction and loyalty. We work with trusted lending partners (Banks, NBFCs, FinTechs) to

develop and offer RBI-compliant, digital credit products embedded in consumer journeys.


Flexmoney was instrumental in working with Banks and merchants to create and establish

the “Cardless EMI” product category in the market, enabling lenders to offer a fully digital

transacting EMI instrument to their users at checkout without the need for a credit card.


We power Cardless affordability for 68,000+ online merchants (including marquee

merchants such as Flipkart, Amazon and MakeMyTrip) across categories such as travel,

insurance, home, fashion, sports, electronics, mobiles, health and wellness.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Product Head to own and drive the product vision, strategy, and

execution for Flexmoney’s affordability platform. This is a high-ownership role for someone

who has built and scaled enterprise / B2B products from early traction to meaningful scale —

ideally through the 1→10 and 10→100 phases. You will lead a team of 6–7 product managers

and work at the intersection of merchants, lenders, and consumers to build the infrastructure

that makes EMI-based purchases seamless across India’s merchant network.


This is not a “maintain and optimize” role – while v1 of our suite is in-market, we foresee a

rich roadmap ahead as commerce increasingly splits into new channels such as social,

influencer-led and agentic. We are looking for someone who can think from first principles,

make hard trade-offs, and build products that merchants/brands and partners genuinely want

to adopt and scale with. In addition, the successful candidate will have a commercial mindset

and work with our Sales, Partner and Business teams to collaboratively identify and ship new

features to drive additional value for our customers and new revenue opportunities for

Flexmoney.


Key Responsibilities:

• You will own the end-to-end product roadmap for Flexmoney’s omni-channel digital

affordability suite — spanning merchant-facing omni-channel commerce journeys

(consumer onboarding, personalized financing offers surfacing, checkout experiences,

merchant dashboard) lender integrations, and consumer EMI experiences.

• In addition, you and your team will define the core digital credit platform roadmap

allowing multi-lender seamless financing as a service in every customer journey

• Define and drive product strategy aligned with business goals, working closely with

the CEO, engineering, business, and lending partnerships teams.

• Lead, mentor, and scale a product team of 5–7 PMs — setting the bar for rigour in

problem definition, prioritisation, and execution.

• Be the voice of the customer. Deeply understand merchant and partner needs, pain

points, and workflows to build products that drive adoption, activation, and retention.

• Drive platform scalability — you’ve been through the messy middle of scaling a product

from early-stage traction to a platform serving thousands of businesses, and you know

what breaks and what holds.

• Own key product metrics: merchant activation rates, EMI transaction conversion,

disbursal throughput, lender partner NPS, and platform reliability.

• Work with engineering to make smart technical trade-offs, manage technical debt,

and ship with velocity without compromising quality.

• Build and institutionalise product processes — discovery, spec writing, sprint planning,

launch readiness, and post-launch reviews — appropriate for Flexmoney’s stage.


Qualifications:

Must-Have:

• 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3–4 years in Ecommerce /

commerce enablement / Enterprise / B2B / B2B2C product roles.

• Demonstrated experience scaling products through the 1→10 and 10→100 growth

phases — not just 0→1 ideation.

• Strong merchant-facing or partner-facing product experience — you’ve built products

where the buyer is a business (not a consumer), and you understand enterprise sales

cycles, integration complexity, and partner success.

• Experience managing and growing a product team of 6+ people, including hiring,

coaching, and performance management.

• Ability to operate at both the strategic (quarterly roadmap, market positioning) and

tactical (user stories, edge cases, release management) levels.

• Strong analytical skills — comfortable with data, metrics, and making decisions with

imperfect information.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with C-

suite, engineering leadership, and external partners.


Strong Bonus:

• Prior experience in lending, fintech, payments, or consumer credit / EMI infrastructure.

• Familiarity with India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, BBPS, Account Aggregator) and how it

shapes product design in financial services.

• Experience with platform / marketplace dynamics — multi-sided products where you’re

serving merchants, lenders, and consumers simultaneously.

• Background in checkout, payment gateway, EMI, or point-of-sale product ecosystems.


Why Flexmoney?

• You’ll have an opportunity to work closely with the Founder/CEO of the Company and

real influence on Company direction.

• Flexmoney sits at the intersection of affordability, payments, and commerce —

powering how India’s merchants make purchases accessible through EMI.

• Small, high-calibre team (~60 people) with deep domain expertise in banking,

consumer internet, and infrastructure — zero bureaucracy.

• The product-market fit is proven with 73M+ credit-verified users and 68,000+

merchants. The opportunity now is to scale — which is exactly the kind of problem this

role is designed to solve.

title: Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
Project Role : Enterprise Architect

Project Role Description : Define and implement enterprise architecture strategies and operating models. Articulate a compelling enterprise architecture vision, target state, and transformation roadmap.

Must have skills : .NET Architecture

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

AI POWERED TECH TALENT

Seeking a forward-thinking professional with an AI-first mindset to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade solutions using Generative and Agentic AI frameworks that drive innovation, efficiency, and business transformation.

Roles & Responsibilities: Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery by applying GenAI and Agentic AI to address complex business challenges, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise workflows for measurable impact.

Professional & Technical Skills: Strong grasp of Generative and Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks. Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization.

Overview:

We are seeking a seasoned Full Stack Enterprise Architect with deep expertise in designing and implementing application-heavy, multi-cloud enterprise solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in applications, infrastructure and integration, with hands-on experience in .NET Core, MVC Framework and Python, as well as exposure to modern front-end technologies like React or Angular. A solid understanding of AI and its integration into enterprise systems is essential. This role will drive the architecture of scalable, secure, and innovative solutions to support business objectives across multiple cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities: Solution Architecture: Design end-to-end, application-heavy enterprise architectures that integrate infrastructure, applications, data and platforms across multi-cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

Application Development Leadership: Lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable applications with a focus on full-stack development, ensuring alignment with business goals.

Integration Strategy: Architect seamless integrations between systems, applications, and third-party services using APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

Multi-Cloud Strategy: Develop and implement strategies for deploying and managing applications across multiple cloud platforms, ensuring portability, scalability, and cost optimization.

Technology Leadership: Provide technical guidance on .NET, and Python-based backend systems, and modern front-end frameworks like React or Angular.

AI Adoption: Incorporate GenAI/Agentic AI capabilities into enterprise applications, leveraging frameworks and tools to enhance productivity & functionality (e.g., predictive analytics, automation).

Infrastructure Design: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design cloud-native solutions, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and IaC (Terraform, Bicep).

Performance & Security: Ensure solutions are optimized for performance, scalability, and security, adhering to industry standards and best practices.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, developers, DevOps, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.

Innovation & Trends: Stay updated on emerging technologies, including AI advancements, cloud trends, and full-stack development practices, to drive continuous improvement.

Qualifications & Skills: Experience: 12 to 20+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, with at least 3 to 5 years in a full-stack architect role focusing on application-heavy solutions.

Proven track record of designing and deploying solutions in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

Hands-on experience with .NET Core, ASP.Net and Python for backend development.

Exposure to front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or similar frameworks.

Strong understanding of AI concepts and their application in enterprise systems.

Expertise in integration patterns (e.g., REST, Azure Integration Services, GraphQL, Kafka, message queues) and microservices architecture.

Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Fabrics, Hadoop, Spark) and data integration pipelines.

Experience with infrastructure components such as containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and IaC tools (Terraform, Bicep).

Understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and logging tools.

Knowledge of enterprise security practices, including IAM, encryption, and compliance standards.

Soft Skills:

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and leadership abilities to guide cross-functional teams.

Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language.

Proactive, innovative mindset with a focus on delivering scalable solutions.

Education: Bachelor s or master s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Fundamentals, TOGAF, DevOps Engineer Expert or similar) are a plus., 15 years full time education

title: AI Red Team Unit Lead
descriptionHtml:
HDFC Bank is looking for a highly experienced and technically strong AI Red Team Unit Lead to build, operationalize, and lead the Bank’s AI Red Team function. This is a strategic yet deeply hands-on leadership role, responsible for designing and executing adversarial attack simulations on both traditional systems and cutting-edge AI systems.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Offensive Security Testing, AI Security, Agentic AI systems, and Red Team operations, with the ability to establish enterprise-grade offensive AI frameworks.

title: Director - Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Director – Data collection tech.


Team: The Data Collections Technology team is the foundational platform collection engine for PitchBook. Our mission is to architect, build, and operate the unified Acquisition, Processing, and Management Platforms that power PitchBook's proprietary data engine. We focus exclusively on engineering highly scalable, resilient, and secure systems that transform vast volumes of raw external data into structured, high-quality, and actionable data assets for the entire business.


As a core team of globally distributed Software Engineers, we are responsible for the architectural integrity and operational excellence of mission-critical systems, including the core ETL/ELT infrastructure, data storage services, and the frameworks that ensure robust data quality and governance.


We operate as a center of excellence for platform delivery, driving high-leverage outcomes by collaborating cross-functionally, cross-divisionally, and across business units. The Director of this team, reporting to the Sr. Director of Engineering, Data Collections Technology, will partner closely with Data Operations to industrialize data collection workflows, Data Collections Product to define platform capabilities, and peer Engineering teams to standardize best practices for large-scale data ingestion and processing. Our success is measured by the reliability, efficiency, and throughput of our data processing infrastructure, directly enabling the business to accelerate coverage and deliver timely insights to our customers.


As the Director of Data Collections Technology, you will define and execute the comprehensive technology strategy for acquiring, processing, and integrating PitchBook’s proprietary public and private market data. You will be directly accountable for the teams building, and operating the end-to-end Data Collection pipelines and tools which empower PitchBook business. Solutions encompass robust, scalable ingestion pipelines, resilient data storage solutions, and the intelligent systems that ensure PitchBook’s data is as accurate, comprehensive, and timely as possible.


In this high-impact role, you will lead a diverse, global organization of Engineers driving both architectural innovation and operational excellence for mission-critical systems. You will define the multi-year technical roadmap for automation, scalability, and quality across all core data domains, ensuring the entire technology stack delivers production-grade reliability and directly powers PitchBook’s data ingestion and platform accuracy.


Your leadership will guide the design, deployment, and optimization of the entire technology ecosystem, from low-latency data acquisition services to coordinating with centralized AI/ML teams to leverage advanced AI-driven extraction and enrichment models (e.g., document AI, entity resolution, and quality validation). You will also play a key role in shaping the data colletions strategy across all of PitchBook and our parent company Morningstar, in collaboration with Product, Data Operations, and the core Engineering teams, ensuring consistency, reliability, and alignment with overarching business outcomes.


This role demands a technically credible and outcome-oriented leader with an AI first mindset. One who can balance strategic accountability with hands-on technical oversight, and who can influence executive stakeholders across the organization while ensuring the continued growth and professional development of a globally distributed, high-performing technical team.


Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Define and execute the unified platform technology strategy for data acquisition, processing, and management across the organization with an AI first mindset.
  • Partner with senior leadership to define the multi-year engineering roadmap that drives scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency in data collection.
  • Establish and own operational KPIs for platform throughput, latency, and system availability across all production environments.
  • Lead, hire, and develop a high-performing team of platform and software engineers; define clear roles and technical career progression.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, and accountability for critical production systems across distributed offices.
  • Champion hiring, technical mentorship, and professional development initiatives to grow internal platform engineering talent.
  • Elevate engineering excellence through technical guidance, design reviews, and architectural decision records (ADRs) for core platform engineers.
  • Act as a multiplier by shaping and enforcing best practices for distributed systems design, CI/CD, and data pipeline governance.
  • Guide and influence cross-functional, cross-division, and cross-business unit teams toward cohesive, reusable, and standards-aligned platform architectures.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, and Data Operations to ensure seamless delivery and integration of core platform services into collection workflows.
  • Partner with data quality and governance teams to define and embed platform-level data quality frameworks and compliance standards.
  • Serve as the trusted technical and strategic advisor on data collection platform capabilities to stakeholders across the business.
  • Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of the unified data collection platform, from architectural planning to deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
  • Ensure high availability, nine-nines reliability, and performance of all mission-critical production platform services.
  • Implement and maintain strong standards of data integrity, security, and governance across all platform components and data pipelines.


Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (Master’s degree preferred).
  • 18+ years of experience in large-scale software engineering or platform architecture, including 7+ years leading technical teams; experience managing managers and geographically distributed teams is strongly preferred.
  • Proven success designing and delivering high-throughput, low-latency data ingestion and processing platforms at scale within a commercial environment
  • Deep, practical expertise in distributed systems architecture (e.g., event-driven architecture, microservices, stream processing), data modeling, and designing for system reliability and fault tolerance.
  • Expert-level knowledge of cloud-native architecture (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern infrastructure-as-code (IaC) principles.
  • Proficiency in managing and optimizing large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and ensuring data governance and integrity within a complex, regulated data environment.
  • Strong understanding of DataOps and MLOps principles as they apply to platform tooling, including automated deployment, monitoring, and performance optimization for critical data infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to define, communicate, and execute multi-year platform engineering roadmaps with measurable business impact on reliability and efficiency.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and influencing skills—including experience presenting technical strategy to executive and cross-functional leadership.
  • A track record of fostering technical excellence, quality assurance, and a security-first mindset across global, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience in fintech, core data platforms, or large-scale information extraction systems is strongly preferred.
  • Contributions to the platform engineering community (e.g., technical publications, open-source projects, or conference presentations on distributed systems) are a strong plus.


Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.

title: D&T Lead – Intelligent Automation
descriptionHtml:
About General Mills

General Mills makes food the world loves—across 100 brands in 100 countries. With a 150+ year legacy and iconic brands such as Cheerios, Pillsbury, Betty Crocker, Nature Valley, and Häagen-Dazs, the General Mills India Center (GIC) in Mumbai serves as a global capability center driving innovation, scale, and digital transformation.

The Digital & Technology (D&T) organization leads enterprise transformation across AI/ML, Automation, Data, Cloud, Enterprise Platforms, and Digital Engineering.

Role Purpose

The Lead D&T – Intelligent Automation is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining, architecting, and scaling enterprise-wide intelligent automation solutions across General Mills’ global operations.

This role acts as a hands-on technical authority and strategic influencer, partnering with business, Enterprise Architecture, Data & AI, and platform teams to deliver secure, scalable, and future-ready automation solutions across RPA, low-code/no-code, enterprise integrations, and emerging agentic and AI-driven automation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Full-time graduation from an accredited university.
  • 14+ years of experience in Digital & Technology with deep expertise in Intelligent Automation and enterprise platforms.
  • Proven track record delivering large-scale automation programs in global enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with RPA and low-code/no-code platforms (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Microsoft Power Automate, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
  • Solid expertise in enterprise integrations, APIs (REST/SOAP), messaging, and event-driven architectures.
  • Strong grounding in automation architecture, orchestration, exception handling, observability, scalability, and resilience.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Agentic Automation frameworks, AI orchestration, and AI/ML integration.
  • Domain experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or operations-driven enterprises.
  • Experience working in global delivery models and agile-at-scale environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and enterprise automation governance and security.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead the enterprise Intelligent Automation strategy across RPA, low-code/no-code, workflow, and AI-enabled automation.
  • Architect scalable, secure automation solutions integrated with core enterprise platforms (ERP, Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, HR, Data).
  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex, high-impact automation initiatives from design through production.
  • Drive API-first, event-driven, and service-oriented integration patterns aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Lead adoption of Agentic Automation, AI orchestration, GenAI, LLMs, and human-in-the-loop automation models.
  • Establish automation standards, reusable components, and governance to ensure quality, performance, scalability, and security.
  • Provide architectural oversight, conduct technical and design reviews, and resolve complex automation and integration challenges.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to business and D&T leadership, translating technology into measurable business value.
  • Mentor senior engineers and strengthen the Intelligent Automation engineering community.

title: Data & Ml Platform Lead
descriptionHtml:
This role is for one of our clients
Industry: Retail

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Location: Bengaluru, Mumbai

JobType: full-time

Focus Areas: (i) Data Platform Engineering, (ii) ML Platform & MLOps, (iii) Platform Operations & FinOps, (iv) Data Governance & Quality

Experience: 14-20 years total | 8-12 years in Data/ML Platform Engineering

Core Platform: Databricks Intelligence Platform (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, MLflow, Mosaic AI)

The Context

We are currently developing the “v2.0” intelligence layer atop this Lakehouse—aiming to standardize MLOps, expand Agentic AI capabilities, and guarantee that the platform delivers sub-second latency across the entire retail network, which includes tens of thousands of stores and high-traffic digital channels.

The Data & ML Platforms group (Group A in Enterprise IT) serves as the driving force behind this transformation. It is led by a VP (L2) and organized into four AVP-led pillars, supported by 10 AI-ready Platform Engineers and a transitioning team of Data Engineers. Each AVP is responsible for a specific platform layer and functions as a builder-leader—expected not only to manage but also to architect, perform code reviews, and actively contribute to development alongside their team.

The Four Pillars

We are seeking to hire four AVPs, each heading one of the platform pillars. While each AVP has full ownership of their respective pillar, all four collaborate closely as a unified leadership team under the VP. Candidates may be evaluated for placement in any pillar depending on their strengths and fit.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Artificial Intelligence Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.

EisnerAmper is seeking an AI Manager who will play a key role in the development and implementation of the EisnerAI Platform, supporting the technical architecture that powers EisnerAmper's intelligent solutions across tax, audit, outsourcing, and advisory services. This role will contribute to delivering innovative AI solutions and lead a team of developers and engineers to help advance our vision of becoming an industry-leading AI-powered professional services firm.

What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:

  • You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
  • You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
  • You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
  • We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
  • We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
  • Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

What Work You Will be Responsible For:

  • Support the integration across the platform's Data Management, Governance, AI, Agents, and Application layers.
  • Contribute to model evaluation frameworks and post-training optimization for custom LLMs and AI agents.
  • Lead and mentor a team of developers and engineers working on the EisnerAI Agent Workforce.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and stakeholders to design and implement scalable AI solutions.
  • Design and develop agentic frameworks supporting initiation, execution, state management, logging, and error handling.
  • Ensure adherence to data governance policies and responsible AI practices.
  • Participate in technical reviews, code reviews, and solution design discussions.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of AI initiatives.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field.
  • Master’s degree preferred (Computer Science, AI/ML, or MBA with technical focus).
  • 6+ years of software development experience with 2+ years in AI/ML solution architecture or technical leadership role.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Azure cloud services and enterprise-scale solutions.
  • Experience leading small to mid-sized technical teams or managing project deliverables.

Must-Have Skills:

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and the broader Azure AI services ecosystem.
  • Proven experience with Azure OpenAI Service, including GPT models, prompt engineering, and fine-tuning.
  • Experience implementing Azure AI Search, including vector search, semantic search, and knowledge mining use cases.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks for data engineering and machine learning model development.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or SQL.
  • Strong understanding of AI solution design principles and enterprise application integration.
  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

Good-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning, including MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with Azure Cognitive Services, such as Document Intelligence, Language Understanding, and Computer Vision.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML frameworks including TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Exposure to vector databases such as Azure Cosmos DB, Pinecone, or Weaviate.
  • Experience with DevOps and MLOps practices, including Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

About EisnerAmper:

EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with approximately 450 partners and 4,500 employees across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.

Our clients represent enterprises of every form, ranging from sophisticated financial institutions to startups, global public firms to middle-market companies, governmental entities as well as high-net-worth individuals, family offices, nonprofit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, investors, and key stakeholders who serve these clients.

About EisnerAmper India:

EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of EisnerAmper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group, and EisnerAmper LLP.

EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 900 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.

Should you need any accommodations to complete this application please email: india.recruiting@eisneramper.com

Preferred Location:

Mumbai

title: Associate Director- Product Design (UI UX) - Immediate joiners preferred
descriptionHtml:
Designation: Associate Design Director: Product & AI Experiences

Location: Andheri West


We don't need another designer. We need someone who can walk into ambiguity, find the real problem, create clarity, align people around a direction, and ship products that move businesses forward. We are looking for a product leader who understands that AI is changing how products are discovered, used, and experienced. Someone who can help clients move beyond screens and workflows to create intelligent, adaptive, and AI-native experiences. If your biggest strength is making beautiful screens, this role is probably not for you. If your biggest strength is solving problems, challenging assumptions, leading people, and creating products that customers actually adopt, keep reading.


What We Believe


Technology was never the problem. Most enterprises already have plenty of it. The problem is that products are often built around systems, departments, and requirements instead of customers, behaviour, and outcomes. At BOMBAYDC, we help enterprises build intelligent digital platforms for the AI era. We work at the intersection of strategy, product thinking, design, behavioural science, and engineering. The next generation of products will not be defined by interfaces alone. They will be defined by intelligence. AI is changing how people search, decide, buy, learn, and interact with products. We believe the best product leaders will not simply design screens, they will design systems where human, business, and machine intelligence work together to create better outcomes.


The Person We Are Looking For


  • Thinks in outcomes, not deliverables.
  • Questions brief instead of blindly executing them.
  • Can translate business goals into product direction.
  • Has strong product judgement and systems thinking.
  • Can influence clients, stakeholders, and teams.
  • Raises the quality of everyone around them.
  • Uses AI as a force multiplier for thinking, research, prototyping, and execution.
  • Understands how AI is reshaping customer behaviour, products, and businesses.
  • Takes ownership, stays curious, and never stops learning.


Your Mission


You will lead some of the most important work inside the company. You will:


  • Own product strategy and experience direction for large engagements.
  • Turn ambiguous client problems into clear product opportunities.
  • Work directly with founders, enterprise CXOs, designers, and engineers.
  • Mentor teams and raise the quality of product thinking across the company.
  • Help enterprises rethink products and experiences for an AI-native future.
  • Shape intelligent experiences where AI enhances customer outcomes and business performance.
  • Drive adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes, not just design outputs.


What Success Looks Like After 12 months


  • Clients trust your judgement without needing founder intervention.
  • Designers seek your guidance because you consistently improve their work.
  • Projects become sharper, faster, and more outcome-driven.
  • You uncover product and AI opportunities others miss.
  • You become a force multiplier for both the company and our clients.

What We Do Care About


  • Product thinking.
  • Leadership.
  • Systems thinking.
  • Business understanding.
  • Communication.
  • Curiosity.
  • Craft.
  • AI fluency.
  • AI-native ways of working.


What We Don't Care About


  • Fancy process without impact.
  • UX buzzwords.
  • Portfolios that only showcase visuals.
  • Waiting for instructions.
  • Blaming clients, developers, or stakeholders.


3 Great Reasons To Work With Us


We are small but global. Our multidisciplinary team has worked in Mumbai, Barcelona, London, Stockholm, and Tokyo. Get it right, and you'll work with some of the best talent in the world. To us, people are everything. Your growth is as important to us as it is to you. While we don't have beer taps (yet!), we've created a restriction-free, high-energy environment where people can do their best work. Our larger purpose? We believe design and technology can contribute to a better life and a better India. Our ultimate goal is to harness creativity for national development while pursuing excellence in both arts and technology.


Benefits @ BOMBAYDC


  • Stay close to your family: Work for up to 2 weeks each year from your hometown if you've relocated to Mumbai.
  • Breathe easy with lesser travel: If your commute exceeds 60 minutes one way, you can work from home every Tuesday and Thursday after confirmation.
  • We protect your Grey Matter: Our HR team is always available to support, listen, and counsel whenever needed.
  • Winter Break: Enjoy an extended year-end break to spend quality time with family and recharge.
  • Extended Long Weekends: We thoughtfully design our holiday calendar to give you more opportunities to unwind.
  • Caregiver Leave: Take time off or work remotely when family members need your care during medical emergencies.
  • We Invest in You: Through learning subsidies, mentorship opportunities, and direct access to founders.
  • We Appreciate Performance: Through Project Excellence Awards and milestone celebrations throughout your journey with us.

Who This Role Is Perfect For


  • Someone who has spent years designing products and now wants a bigger canvas.
  • Someone who wants influence, ownership, and responsibility.
  • Someone who wants to help build the next generation of intelligent digital products.
  • Someone who could eventually become a Pod Head, Associate Partner, or future leader within BOMBAYDC.


Self-Test


If you read this and thought:


  • That's exactly how I think.
  • I already operate this way.
  • I want more ownership than my current role gives me.
  • I care more about solving problems


We should talk

title: Senior Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
AryaXAI offers one of the most reliable, safe, and performant platforms for building Expert AI Agents & Models for mission-critical use cases. We stand at the forefront of AI innovation, revolutionizing AI for mission-critical businesses by solving the most critical challenges in AI interpretability, alignment, and AI risk. Through our research labs in Mumbai, Paris, and London, we produce state-of-the-art techniques, models, and open-source tools. The platform integrates these components and scales them to the users and usage as needed. We are ardent supporters of OSS, and we not only open-source our research but also integrate multiple OSS to deliver the scale. 

At AryaXAI, everyone contributes hands-on to our mission in a flat organizational structure that values curiosity, initiative, and exceptional performance.

Qualifications:

We are now looking for highly experienced Senior Engineering Managers who can lead the platform scale and components, and make it the industry best in the relevant components. Ideal candidates should have at least 5+ years of experience working with products that require heavy engineering and scaling requirements. Preference is from a product background with strong discipline around the stack and PR quality. 

  • 5+ years of experience in building and deploying enterprise-grade machine learning infra, SaaS software, data analytics solutions, or online platforms
  • 2+ years of experience in building LLM infra or high-volume AI inference components. 
  • Academic degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Strong background in Python programming, Distributed computing, Engineering, big data processing, and cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP, on-premises)
  • Experience in optimizing, scaling, and reliability of large-scale systems for various data modalities and AI models.
  • Strong fundamentals and discipline in CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and multi-cloud environments.
  • Proven track record in product management in designing and delivering complex, high-performance solutions for large-scale enterprise customers without faults and the ability to auto-scale the systems through delivering the essential SLAs in production during inference
  • Programming skills - expert in Python and solid coding practices
  • Data Engineering - expert in MongoDB and strong fundamentals in data lakes, data storage, ETL pipelines, and building real-time data pipelines.
  • Strong material skills, excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to lead teams, mentor juniors, and work with other teams.
  • Strong system architecture background that supports scaling in regulated industries.
  • Experience in scaling AI/ML production systems using classic ML models, LLMs, and Deep Learning models on traditional hardware and high-performance computing.


Roles and responsibilities

As Sr Engineering Manager, you'll be the main SPOC for all the engineering efforts behind the AryaXAI platform, serving customers in SaaS and on-premise modes and scaling multiple AI models in startups, SMEs, and highly regulated industries.

  • You'll be responsible for designing, modifying, and scaling architecture, as well as designing and implementing scalable infrastructure for AI/ML solutions and data engineering.
  • You'll be the SPOC with the R&D team, collecting the productized components and adding and scaling these components on the platform.
  • Architect and scale AI inference platform and related components for all data modalities like Tabular, text, image, video, etc.
  • You'll be responsible for designing the AI Ops and AI Inferencing Ops - model building, data preprocessing, model inferencing, explainability, monitoring, alignment, risk management components.
  • You'll work on running multiple optimizations on inference speed and latencies to serve multiple AI models - LLMs, DL models, classic ML models, etc.
  • You'll manage product development activities, including scrum reviews and productivity optimization across engineering, as well as collaborate with R&D/data science and front-end teams.
  • You'll mentor and guide juniors and middle managers.
  • You'll continuously improve the standards of the product, as well as the architecture, culture, and experience.


What you’ll get: 

  • Highly competitive and meaningful compensation package
  • One of the best health care plans that covers not only you but also your family, and offers the best Life insurance plans.
  • A great team
  • Micro-entrepreneurial tasks and responsibilities.
  • Career development and leadership opportunities

title: AI-Data Solutions Lead -Vice President
descriptionHtml:
Overview Of The Role

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients' best interests. Our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

As a Vice President Data Analyst in the Enterprise Data Office Data Solutions team based in our Mumbai office, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping our Enterprise Risk Management data as an asset strategy. This position demands a seasoned professional with deep expertise in data analytics, a proven track record in applying advanced AI/ML techniques in solving business problems, and exceptional leadership skills to drive strategic initiatives, mentor a high-performing team, and deliver impactful, executive-level presentations. You will be instrumental in advancing our data solutioning and analytics capabilities within a dynamic global financial environment.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We'll enable growth and progress together.

Responsibilities

Lead and mentor a team of junior data analysts, fostering their professional growth, developing their technical and soft skills, and ensuring high-quality, impactful deliverables.

  • Data Solutions Delivery:
    • Provide expertise on Data Governance and/or Data Risk and Controls framework including design, effectiveness, performance monitoring and self-assessment processes
    • Oversight and analysis of data-related issues, tracking of ownership and target dates and associated metrics and reporting
  • Drive the adoption of best practices in data analysis, data governance, and project management across the team and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Leadership & Mentoring:
  • Lead and mentor a team of junior data analysts, fostering their professional growth, developing their technical and soft skills, and ensuring high-quality, impactful deliverables.
  • Drive the adoption of best practices in data analysis, data governance, and project management across the team and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
  • AI/Advanced Analytics Strategy & Implementation:
  • Spearhead the integration and advanced application of Agentic AI, LLM, and other Generative AI (GenAI) tools to develop sophisticated and innovative data analytical solutions for Enterprise Risk Management.
  • Define, develop, and implement AI/ML strategies for predictive modeling, advanced anomaly detection, automated reporting, and enhanced risk insights within the financial risk domain.
  • Evaluate and recommend new AI/ML technologies and methodologies to continuously improve data analysis and reporting capabilities.
  • Strategic Impact & Executive Presentations:
  • Proactively identify strategic data opportunities and challenges, proposing innovative solutions to enhance Enterprise Risk Management capabilities and reporting effectiveness.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling, standout presentations and strategic updates to senior management, global stakeholders, and internal forums, translating complex data insights into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations.
  • Core Data Analysis & Governance:
  • Provide in-depth leadership in system and data analysis to support Enterprise Risk Management data initiatives, ensuring strict alignment with Citi's data governance policies (CDGP) and standards (CDGS) framework.
  • Oversee the comprehensive gathering and documentation of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) for complex data-centric projects, including detailed specifications for data quality rules, data lineage, and data layer components, partnering closely with technology teams to ensure robust implementation.
  • Actively manage, update, and ensure timely resolution of project artifacts, tasks, issues, and action items within JIRA or similar project management tools, maintaining accurate tracking of progress and dependencies.
  • Contribute strategically to the design, documentation, and maintenance of logical and physical data layers, including advanced data models, data dictionaries, and data lineage, to ensure robust, scalable, and efficient data solutions for Enterprise Risk Management.
  • Lead efforts to identify, analyze, and troubleshoot complex data quality gaps and issues, collaborating with business data owners and technology teams to propose and implement effective remediation strategies and monitoring routines.
  • Rigorously review and validate business requirements, data lineage, and supporting documentation for downstream risk reporting and analytics solutions, ensuring consistency, traceability, and governance alignment.
  • Oversee the creation and maintenance of detailed data flow diagrams, process maps, and system documentation, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Actively participate in data governance forums and strategically support the implementation of reporting and tooling for the ERM Data Operating Model.
  • Assist with the tracking and remediation of RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) log items and overall project progress against established plans.
  • Collaborate with business data owners to understand existing data processes and contribute to defining new, innovative requirements for end-to-end data solutions.

Qualifications

  • Experience:
    • 13+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business analysis, or systems analysis, with a strong emphasis on data quality initiatives, AI driven data analytics, and system implementation, preferably within a leadership or senior specialist capacity.
  • AI/Technical Skills:
    • Demonstrated advanced proficiency and practical application of Agentic AI, LLM, and GenAI tools for developing innovative data analytical solutions. Experience in designing and implementing AI/ML-driven data solutions is essential.
    • Expert-level proficiency in data analysis and management tools and applications, including Oracle, PL-SQL, advanced data lineage tools, and enterprise data cataloging solutions.
    • Strong familiarity with business intelligence and reporting concepts (e.g., dashboards, metrics, and reporting layers); extensive hands-on experience reviewing documentation for BI tools such as Tableau is a significant plus.
  • Leadership & Mentoring:
    • Proven leadership experience, including mentoring junior team members, fostering skill development, and leading cross-functional projects.
    • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision, taking full ownership of initiatives, and driving them to successful completion from conception to delivery.
  • Domain Expertise:
    • Extensive prior experience (minimum 6 years) in the banking or financial services industry is required, with deep exposure to enterprise risk management or specific risk management categories, including a strategic understanding of the role of data in risk reporting, monitoring, and decision-making.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with the ability to interpret highly complex data requirements, synthesize diverse information, and translate them into actionable, executive-level specifications.
    • Superior verbal and written communication skills, capable of articulating highly technical and strategic concepts clearly and persuasively to diverse, senior-level audiences.
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data flowcharting tools, with a proven ability to create visually engaging, data-driven, and highly informative presentations that stand out.
    • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, influence stakeholders, drive consensus, and navigate complex organizational structures in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Education:
    • Bachelor's degree required in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics); Master's degree highly preferred.

title: Lead - Data & Ml Platform
descriptionHtml:
This role is for one of our clients
Industry: Retail

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Location: Bengaluru, Mumbai

JobType: full-time

Focus Areas: (i) Data Platform Engineering, (ii) ML Platform & MLOps, (iii) Platform Operations & FinOps, (iv) Data Governance & Quality

Experience: 14-20 years total | 8-12 years in Data/ML Platform Engineering

Core Platform: Databricks Intelligence Platform (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, MLflow, Mosaic AI)

The Context

We are currently developing the “v2.0” intelligence layer atop this Lakehouse—aiming to standardize MLOps, expand Agentic AI capabilities, and guarantee that the platform delivers sub-second latency across the entire retail network, which includes tens of thousands of stores and high-traffic digital channels.

The Data & ML Platforms group (Group A in Enterprise IT) serves as the driving force behind this transformation. It is led by a VP (L2) and organized into four AVP-led pillars, supported by 10 AI-ready Platform Engineers and a transitioning team of Data Engineers. Each AVP is responsible for a specific platform layer and functions as a builder-leader—expected not only to manage but also to architect, perform code reviews, and actively contribute to development alongside their team.

The Four Pillars

We are seeking to hire four AVPs, each heading one of the platform pillars. While each AVP has full ownership of their respective pillar, all four collaborate closely as a unified leadership team under the VP. Candidates may be evaluated for placement in any pillar depending on their strengths and fit.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Agentic AI Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the role:

Marico Limited is expanding its intelligent automation capabilities beyond traditional RPA into the domain of AI agents — systems that can reason, plan, use tools, and complete multi-step business tasks autonomously. We are looking for an Agentic AI lead who can bridge the gap between advanced AI technology and real business problems across Finance, Supply Chain, HR, Sales, R&D, and Procurement. You will design, build, and deploy AI agents on both low-code platforms (Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Gemini) and code-first frameworks (Microsoft Agent Framework), integrating them with enterprise systems (SAP, Snowflake, M365). This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to leadership and the opportunity to shape Marico's Agentic AI architecture from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Agent Design & Architecture

• Design end-to-end Agentic AI architectures including single-agent and multi-agent systems using patterns such as ReAct, Reflection Pattern.

• Define agent goals, tools, MCP, memory strategies (in-context, external, semantic, episodic), and failure-handling logic.

• Build agentic RAG systems combining vector search, semantic retrieval, and LLM reasoning for knowledge-grounded responses

• Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints for approval workflows, exceptions, and escalation scenarios

2. Development & Integration

• Build and configure agents on Microsoft Copilot Studio with custom connectors, adaptive cards, and Power Automate flow integrations

• Develop AI agents using Python-based frameworks for code-first builds

• Integrate agents with enterprise APIs: SAP, Snowflake (Cortex), Microsoft Graph API, SharePoint, Teams, and other M365 services etc.

• Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to expose tools and data sources to agents in a standardized, composable manner

• Build tool-calling layers that allow agents to interact with databases, ERPs, and third-party APIs in real time

3. RAG & Knowledge Management

• Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines: document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector store indexing, and context-aware retrieval

• Work with vector databases (Pinecone, Azure AI Search, ChromaDB) to build semantic search capabilities for enterprise knowledge bases

• Implement agentic RAG patterns including query routing, self-reflection, and query reformulation for higher-quality responses

4. Evaluation, Testing & Observability

• Build evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, task completion rate, hallucination rate, and latency

• Implement observability and tracing to debug and improve agent behaviour in production

• Define and monitor KPIs for deployed agents; establish feedback loops for continuous improvement

• Conduct structured prompt engineering and system prompt optimization to improve reliability and output quality

5. Governance, Safety & Responsible AI

• Implement guardrails, content filters, and safety mechanisms to ensure agents behave within defined boundaries

• Apply responsible AI principles: fairness, transparency, explainability, and data privacy compliance

6. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

• Partner with business process owners to translate operational problems into agent design briefs

• Collaborate with vendors in development and adoption of automation

• Present agent capabilities, prototypes, and performance reports to senior leadership including CIO-level audiences


Qualifications:

Mandatory

• 4–6 years of experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or intelligent automation

• Hands-on experience building at least 5 production-grade AI agent or LLM-powered application/automation

• Strong Python programming skills with demonstrated proficiency in LLM libraries and API integration

• Experience with at least one agent framework

• Understanding of RAG architecture and vector search fundamentals

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field


Preferred / Nice-to-Have

• Experience with Microsoft-centric enterprise stacks: M365, Power Platform, Azure, SAP

• Familiarity with RPA tools (UiPath, Power Automate Desktop) and RPA-to-AI agent bridge architectures
