descriptionText:
About the role:
Marico Limited is expanding its intelligent automation capabilities beyond traditional RPA into the domain of AI agents — systems that can reason, plan, use tools, and complete multi-step business tasks autonomously. We are looking for an Agentic AI lead who can bridge the gap between advanced AI technology and real business problems across Finance, Supply Chain, HR, Sales, R&D, and Procurement. You will design, build, and deploy AI agents on both low-code platforms (Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Gemini) and code-first frameworks (Microsoft Agent Framework), integrating them with enterprise systems (SAP, Snowflake, M365). This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to leadership and the opportunity to shape Marico's Agentic AI architecture from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities:
1. Agent Design & Architecture
• Design end-to-end Agentic AI architectures including single-agent and multi-agent systems using patterns such as ReAct, Reflection Pattern.
• Define agent goals, tools, MCP, memory strategies (in-context, external, semantic, episodic), and failure-handling logic.
• Build agentic RAG systems combining vector search, semantic retrieval, and LLM reasoning for knowledge-grounded responses
• Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints for approval workflows, exceptions, and escalation scenarios
2. Development & Integration
• Build and configure agents on Microsoft Copilot Studio with custom connectors, adaptive cards, and Power Automate flow integrations
• Develop AI agents using Python-based frameworks for code-first builds
• Integrate agents with enterprise APIs: SAP, Snowflake (Cortex), Microsoft Graph API, SharePoint, Teams, and other M365 services etc.
• Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to expose tools and data sources to agents in a standardized, composable manner
• Build tool-calling layers that allow agents to interact with databases, ERPs, and third-party APIs in real time
3. RAG & Knowledge Management
• Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines: document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector store indexing, and context-aware retrieval
• Work with vector databases (Pinecone, Azure AI Search, ChromaDB) to build semantic search capabilities for enterprise knowledge bases
• Implement agentic RAG patterns including query routing, self-reflection, and query reformulation for higher-quality responses
4. Evaluation, Testing & Observability
• Build evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, task completion rate, hallucination rate, and latency
• Implement observability and tracing to debug and improve agent behaviour in production
• Define and monitor KPIs for deployed agents; establish feedback loops for continuous improvement
• Conduct structured prompt engineering and system prompt optimization to improve reliability and output quality
5. Governance, Safety & Responsible AI
• Implement guardrails, content filters, and safety mechanisms to ensure agents behave within defined boundaries
• Apply responsible AI principles: fairness, transparency, explainability, and data privacy compliance
6. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
• Partner with business process owners to translate operational problems into agent design briefs
• Collaborate with vendors in development and adoption of automation
• Present agent capabilities, prototypes, and performance reports to senior leadership including CIO-level audiences


Qualifications:
Mandatory 
• 4–6 years of experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or intelligent automation
• Hands-on experience building at least 5 production-grade AI agent or LLM-powered application/automation
• Strong Python programming skills with demonstrated proficiency in LLM libraries and API integration
• Experience with at least one agent framework
• Understanding of RAG architecture and vector search fundamentals
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field


Preferred / Nice-to-Have
• Experience with Microsoft-centric enterprise stacks: M365, Power Platform, Azure, SAP
• Familiarity with RPA tools (UiPath, Power Automate Desktop) and RPA-to-AI agent bridge architectures
• Exposure to multi-agent orchestration patterns (Orchestrator/Worker, CrewAI role-based agents, AutoGen conversations)
• Experience deploying agents in enterprise environments with SSO, data governance, and compliance requirements
• Certifications in Azure AI / Microsoft Copilot / LangChain
• MBA or management background is an advantage for business-facing AI product roles

title: Head of Hunter Platform and Products - DA
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Experian unlocks the power of data to create opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We gather, analyze and process data in ways others can’t. We help individuals take financial control and access financial services, businesses make smarter decision and thrive, lenders lend more responsibly, and organizations prevent identity fraud and crime. For more than 125 years, we’ve helped consumers and clients prosper, and economies and communities flourish – and we’re not done. Our 17,800 people in 45 countries believe the possibilities for you, and our world, are growing. We’re investing in new technologies, talented people and innovation so we can help create a better tomorrow.

Job Description

Experian India is seeking a strategic and visionary senior leader to head its Fraud and ID Verification Solutions team. This client-facing role is central to driving solution excellence, market leadership, and product innovation in the financial services sector. The ideal candidate will be a recognized expert in fraud prevention and identity verification, capable of translating client challenges into impactful solutions while influencing product strategy and market execution.

In today’s era of data-driven decision-making, Experian is uniquely positioned to solve client problems by being at the forefront of data analysis, solutioning, and innovation. Our platform-first approach enables seamless integration of data from multiple sources, creating a one-stop solution for the financial industry in India.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Strategic Solutioning

  • Lead a team of specialists to engage with clients, deeply understand their fraud and ID verification challenges, and strategically position Experian’s solutions to address these needs.
  • Collaborate with Sales teams on day-to-day sales activities, providing strategic guidance and solution expertise to support deal progression and closure.
  • Ensure that analytics-driven insights are embedded into client conversations and product evolution.
  • Ensure that proposed solutions are optimal, scalable, and aligned with client needs and regulatory frameworks.

Post-Sales Success & Adoption

  • Oversee the transition from sales to onboarding, ensuring smooth implementation and client satisfaction.
  • Drive client adoption and usage of solutions, acting as a strategic advisor to maximize value realization.

Product Feedback & Innovation

  • Serve as the voice of the customer to internal product teams, providing actionable insights on product performance and enhancement opportunities.
  • Influence the development of new features and capabilities based on client feedback and market trends.
  • Work closely with Experian’s highly proficient analytics teams to co-create innovative, data-led solutions.
  • Identify trends across liabilities and assets onboarding, spanning both consumer and MSME segments.
  • Leverage advanced analytics to address fraud not only from a consumer perspective but also through digital device footprints, behavioral signals, and emerging fraud typologies.

Go-To-Market Strategy

  • Partner with GTM and sales teams to launch new Fraud and ID Verification products.
  • Define target segments, positioning, messaging, and market entry strategies.
  • Support enablement and training of sales teams on new offerings.

Industry Leadership & Advocacy

  • Represent Experian at fraud forums, conferences, and industry events.
  • Establish Experian as the leading authority on fraud and ID verification in India’s financial services sector.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across banks, NBFCs, and regulatory bodies.

Community Building & Thought Leadership

  • Lead the planning and execution of the Annual Fraud Closed User Group Summit for Hunter platform users and industry leaders.
  • Manage the Hunter Advisory Board, a quarterly forum of top financial institutions to discuss product evolution and regulatory developments.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate across product, customer success, onboarding, analytics, and GTM teams to drive holistic client outcomes.
  • Inspire and lead a high-performing team of specialists, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and innovation.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience:

  • 15+ years of experience in fraud prevention, identity verification, or related domains within financial services or technology.
  • Proven experience in strategic client engagement and solutioning.
  • Strong understanding of the fraud landscape in India’s financial services sector.
  • Experience in product strategy, GTM planning, and cross-functional leadership.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Prior experience in hosting industry summits or advisory boards is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic influence on sales outcomes and client satisfaction.
  • High adoption and usage rates post-implementation.
  • Strong market presence and thought leadership in the fraud domain.
  • Continuous product improvement driven by client insights.
  • Seamless collaboration across internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Delivery of innovative, data-driven solutions that address emerging fraud patterns.

Why us

  • We’re a high-performance and driven team but we don’t forget to celebrate success
  • We offer strong career and international opportunities for high performers
  • We invest heavily in our products and our people
  • We offer training and support from experienced subject matter experts and managers plus dedicated learning & development time

Additional Information

  • We are looking for someone who:
  • Is a consultative business professional
  • Is confident, clear, certain and consistent
  • Is able to work alongside a sales team managing multiple opportunities concurrently
  • Passionate, resourceful, gracious and adaptable
  • High moral standards, honesty and an ethical approach to doing business
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving skills and ability to see the big-picture & develop conceptual solutions
  • Candidates that have prior relevant work experience, excel in ambiguous situations, and possess a passion for helping companies become more competitive
  • Business acumen combined with a comfort with technology is a must

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here

title: Head of Product - Smart Buildings
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product – Smart Buildings Embassy 247 IT Park, Vikhroli, Mumbai | 15–20 years experience required


Mandatory Requirement

IoT or hardware experience essential. Applicants with SaaS-only backgrounds will not be considered. Freespace (afreespace.com) delivers workplace intelligence through IoT sensors, real time analytics, employee apps, signage, and space management—driving optimized designs, smart automations, and exceptional employee experiences.


Role Overview

Lead product vision, strategy, and execution for global IoT products in occupancy sensing, air quality, energy monitoring, and building management. Bridge customers, vendors, and teams to boost efficiency, sustainability, and occupant experience. Own customer growth, revenue, profitability; manage Product Owners, Analysts, and Solution Experts.


Key Responsibilities

• Define bold product vision/strategy and quarterly roadmaps aligned to growth goals, market trends, and client needs.

• Engage US/UK/global clients in meetings; capture feedback, analyze NPS, and refine offerings.

• Track KPIs (adoption, retention, quality); oversee lifecycle from ideation to scale, reviewing support tickets.

• Drive commercial success: pricing, monetization (subscriptions/licensing), margins via exec collaboration. • Partner with GTM/marketing/sales on positioning, launches, and global product market fit.

• Lead Agile processes: backlog grooming, sprint planning/reviews, trade-offs, fostering autonomous teams.

• Ensure compliance (BACnet/MQTT/Modbus, LEED/BREEAM), security, and vendor integrations for sensors/edge/cloud.

• Communicate roadmaps to stakeholders; champion research on competitors, trends, and customer behavior.


Required Experience & Skills

• 15–20 years in IoT/Smart Buildings (8+ in leadership); proven scaling of enterprise IoT solutions globally. • Commercial expertise: pricing, revenue growth, client negotiations.

• Deep IoT knowledge: sensors, embedded systems, protocols (Wi Fi/BLE/LoRaWAN), edge computing, HVAC/lighting integration.

• Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), data analytics, device-to-cloud comms, cybersecurity (encryption/firmware).

• Agile mastery: user stories, sprints, metrics (NPS/retention); strong analytics and stakeholder management.

• UI prototyping/wireframing; primary/secondary research; negotiation; team leadership. Must-Haves Nice-to-Haves IoT/hardware leadership Energy optimization strategies Global product scaling BMS integrations Agile + commercial ownership Sustainability certifications Ideal Candidate Visionary who thrives in ambiguity, with sharp logic, ideation skills, and cross-team relationship building. Why Freespace?

• Interact with global customers Freespace Confidential • Shape cutting-edge IoT for sustainable workplaces.

• Hybrid flexibility, growth-focused culture.

• Competitive salary/bonus, health benefits, paid leave, training.


Apply now: Send CV to hrindia@afreespace.com by 30th June 2026. We value diverse applicants.

title: Quantitative Analyst- Balance Sheet Management  - Senior Vice President
descriptionHtml:
The Balance Sheet Mgmt Sr Ld Anlst is a strategic professional who closely follows latest trends in own field and adapts them for application within own job and the business. Typically a small number of people within the business that provide the same level of expertise. Excellent communication skills required in order to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Accountable for significant direct business results or authoritative advice regarding the operations of the business. Necessitates a degree of responsibility over technical strategy. Primarily affects a sub-function. Responsible for handling staff management issues, including resource management and allocation of work within the team/project.

Job Title: Senior Vice President, Balance Sheet Analytics & AI Product Management

Responsibilities:

  • Own and direct the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for balance sheet management solutions, with a strong emphasis on applied AI and machine learning.
  • Articulate the product strategy and roadmap to stakeholders at all levels, from executive leadership to engineering teams, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, including the design, prototyping, and deployment of data-driven tools and models. This is a hands-on role requiring the ability to rapidly develop advanced analytics solutions and dashboards using Python and Tableau.
  • Partner with senior leaders in Finance, Treasury, and Technology to identify business opportunities and translate them into technical requirements and product features.
  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring business needs are accurately translated into actionable development work while providing technical guidance.
  • Mentor product and technical teams, establishing best practices for product management and data science within the group.
  • Uphold stringent risk and control standards, demonstrating sound judgment regarding the firm's reputation and assets, particularly concerning data and model governance in the context of AI solution deployment.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in technical product management, quantitative analysis, or data science within the financial services industry. A Master's degree or PhD is highly preferred.
  • A strong portfolio of successfully launched data-intensive products or analytical solutions, demonstrating deep expertise in applied AI/ML.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python for data analysis, modeling, and automation, as well as advanced skills in Tableau for data visualization and dashboard creation.
  • A strong technical foundation with demonstrated experience in rapid prototyping and taking complex analytical products from concept to full deployment.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex technical and financial topics for senior management and guide technical discussions with engineering and data science teams.
  • Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams in a complex, agile environment.
  • Substantial experience in product ownership at a senior level, with a track record of leading the development of significant data or technology infrastructure from a business perspective.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple senior stakeholders, and navigate a fast-paced environment.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Data Science, Finance, Economics, or Statistics is required.
  • A Master's degree in a related technical or quantitative field is preferred.

title: Director of Software Engineering - Big Data, Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.

As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorgan Chase within Corporate Technology, you lead a technical area and drive impact within teams, technologies, and projects across departments. Utilize your in-depth knowledge of software, applications, technical processes, and product management to drive multiple complex projects and initiatives, while serving as a primary decision maker for your teams and be a driver of innovation and solution delivery.

Job Responsibilities

  • Leads the delivery of Trade Surveillance solutions aligned with business goals and regulatory requirements
  • Drives the platform modernization initiative, leveraging Data Mesh principles on Databricks to build scalable, resilient, and efficient big data platforms
  • Provides hands-on technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams, ensuring engineering excellence, secure-by-design, and agile/DevOps best practices
  • Manages multiple feature teams, acting as both a people supervisor and technical leader; hire, develop, mentor, and recognise talent across cross-functional teams
  • Owns decisions on team resources, budgets, and tactical operations, including process execution and continuous optimisation.
  • Evaluates, selects, and integrates emerging technologies—including AI/ML solutions—to enhance surveillance coverage, accuracy, efficiency and also leads and drives AI projects, fostering AI readiness and adoption with the global team.
  • Builds and nurture a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Identifies and mitigate risks across data, models, security, and operations; ensure audit readiness and control compliance.
  • Develops strong partnerships with product, compliance, and LOB Technology also drives transformation and modernisation projects to achieve shared objectives.
  • Sets direction and governance for agentic AI-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation within a technical area to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-orchestrated delivery workflows, release readiness controls, automated test modernisation, and incident triage acceleration), while establishing guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realised by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives at scale

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Solid track record and 10+ years of experience in building large-scale data warehouses, enterprise data platforms, and critical big data solutions
  • Proven experience in cloud implementation and practical cloud-native development with AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Deep expertise in platform building, modernization, and transformation projects, including Data Mesh and Databricks
  • Familiarity with AI/ML technologies and experience leading or driving AI projects
  • Experience developing or leading cross-functional teams of technologists, including hiring, developing, and recognising talent
  • Strong people management skills; ability to supervise, mentor, and grow engineering leaders and teams
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to drive innovation and foster a culture of continuous improvement
  • Experience managing multiple Scrum/feature teams and delivering complex projects in an agile environment
  • Experience leading adoption of agentic AI-enabled engineering practices (using enterprise-authorised tools within the work environment) across teams, including defining operating expectations (human-in-the-loop validation, quality gates), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, resiliency/security implications, and governance; ability to influence leaders on safe scaling patterns and reuse

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience working at code level

- Leads the delivery of Trade Surveillance solutions aligned with business goals and regulatory requirements
- Drives the platform modernization initiative, leveraging Data Mesh principles on Databricks to build scalable, resilient, and efficient big data platforms
- Provides hands-on technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams, ensuring engineering excellence, secure-by-design, and agile/DevOps best practices
- Manages multiple feature teams, acting as both a people supervisor and technical leader; hire, develop, mentor, and recognise talent across cross-functional teams
- Owns decisions on team resources, budgets, and tactical operations, including process execution and continuous optimisation.
- Evaluates, selects, and integrates emerging technologies—including AI/ML solutions—to enhance surveillance coverage, accuracy, efficiency and also leads and drives AI projects, fostering AI readiness and adoption with the global team.
- Builds and nurture a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement.
- Identifies and mitigate risks across data, models, security, and operations; ensure audit readiness and control compliance.
- Develops strong partnerships with product, compliance, and LOB Technology also drives transformation and modernisation projects to achieve shared objectives.
- Sets direction and governance for agentic AI-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation within a technical area to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-orchestrated delivery workflows, release readiness controls, automated test modernisation, and incident triage acceleration), while establishing guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams
- Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realised by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives at scale

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills



- Solid track record and 10+ years of experience in building large-scale data warehouses, enterprise data platforms, and critical big data solutions
- Proven experience in cloud implementation and practical cloud-native development with AWS, Azure, or GCP
- Deep expertise in platform building, modernization, and transformation projects, including Data Mesh and Databricks
- Familiarity with AI/ML technologies and experience leading or driving AI projects
- Experience developing or leading cross-functional teams of technologists, including hiring, developing, and recognising talent
- Strong people management skills; ability to supervise, mentor, and grow engineering leaders and teams
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
- Ability to drive innovation and foster a culture of continuous improvement
- Experience managing multiple Scrum/feature teams and delivering complex projects in an agile environment
- Experience leading adoption of agentic AI-enabled engineering practices (using enterprise-authorised tools within the work environment) across teams, including defining operating expectations (human-in-the-loop validation, quality gates), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs
- Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, resiliency/security implications, and governance; ability to influence leaders on safe scaling patterns and reuse

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills



- Experience working at code level

ABOUT US

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Experian unlocks the power of data to create opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We gather and analyse data in ways others can't. We help individuals take financial control and access financial services, businesses make smarter decision and succeed, lenders lend more responsibly, and organisations prevent identity fraud and crime. For more than 125 years, we've helped consumers and clients prosper, and economies and communities flourish – and we're not done. Our 17,800 people in 45 countries believe the possibilities for you, and our world, are growing. We're investing in new technologies, experienced people and new ideas so we can help create a better tomorrow.

Job Description

What you need to have

  • 8-12 Years of experience in the financial services industry in a product role or business intelligence domain with strong understanding of lending business, payments in the digital team of a Bank, large NBFC or a Fintech.
  • Agile Product development and Data Analytics expertise
  • Experience in actively supporting sales teams achieve revenues and EBIT targets
  • Product Life-cycle experience
  • Preferably should have handled customer lifecycle for D2C & B2B business lines.
  • Experience of collaborative working with cross functional teams

What You’ll Be Accountable For

  • Ownership of overall Product Development and Management for all bureau, analytics and decision products and services.
  • Drive Product Revenue and EBIT targets along with Sales teams
  • Lead Business Case production in line with execution of the roadmap defining investment scale and return on Investment, Payback, etc.

  • Build and anchor the Research, Insight and Thought Leadership publications. Manage the rendering platform for products like standard insights.
  • Manage the scoping and development of enhancements to existing products and solutions with the India/Regional technology teams.
  • Ensuring continuous upskilling of team members technical and communication skills.
  • Internal design consultation for Strategic Accounts, support pre-sales with additional technical and design insights and providing solutions to complex customer problem statements. Drive the scoping and delivery for projects based on client requirements.
  • Keeping self and team updated with new approaches and trends in statistical analysis and data visualisation.

How We Will Measure Your Success

  • New Products / Innovation Revenue
  • Establish Thought Leadership
  • Improving Product EBIT
  • Deliver product roadmap within agreed TAT
  • Deliver platform capacity to align with pipeline and revenue forecasts
  • Support achievement of Revenue Targets by:
  • Delivering the agreed Product roadmap
  • Producing documentation to assist GTM
  • Ensuring the timely availability of the products and solutions
  • Consulting with strategic deals in the Pre-sales phase to support deal closure

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of the consumer and commercial lending ecosystem and its associated data

  • Product Management understanding including product development, commercial acumen and GTM knowledge
  • Demonstrated experience in consulting, solution development and selling
  • Excellent communication, written and presentation skills
  • Strong Program Management skills
  • Proven leadership, coaching and development capabilities
  • Team player, performance driven individual with excellent time-management skills
  • Used to working under tight time pressure, great sense of priority management
  • High level of communication and personal presence
  • Strong market knowledge of latest innovations in the data analytics space and its associated utilization in various industries

Additional Information

Role Location: Mumbai

descriptionHtml:

About The Company

The company is focused on building scalable, cloud-native platforms and driving digital transformation through modern engineering practices and AI-led innovation.

title: Machine Learning & Workplace Analytics, WM Administration, Vice President, Wealth Management
descriptionHtml:
Company Profile

Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals.

At Morgan Stanley India, we support the Firm's global businesses, with critical presence across Institutional Securities, Wealth Management and Investment management, as well as in the Firm's infrastructure functions of Technology, Operations, Finance, Risk Management, Legal and Corporate & Enterprise Services. Morgan Stanley has been rooted in India since 1993, with campuses in both Mumbai and Bengaluru. We empower our multi-faceted and talented teams to advance their careers and make a global impact on the business. For those who show passion and grit in their work, there's ample opportunity to move across the businesses.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer. We work to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals can maximize their full potential. Our skilled and creative workforce is comprised of individuals drawn from a broad cross section of the global communities in which we operate and who reflect a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences. Our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion is evident through our constant focus on recruiting, developing, and advancing individuals based on their skills and talents.

Department Profile

The Analytics & Data (A&D) organization is a key growth area within Morgan Stanley's Wealth Management Division, playing a critical role in the execution of the wider Wealth Management strategy. The team owns all the executive reporting, insights, and predictive modeling in support of Wealth Management business. The use of analytics and data will be a key driver in accelerating growth across client segments, enabling data-driven decision making and delivering the best client experience.

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced professional to join the Analytics & Data organization who can work as a player-coach. The role involves focusing on developing Machine Learning models and Gen AI use cases across WM Business lines. The candidate will be responsible for building end to end Machine learning solutions, coordinating with technology and risk partners to operationalize the model, monitoring and recalibrating the built models, and communicating the impact of models to key stakeholders. The role also requires leveraging LLMs to build Gen AI use cases supporting all WM business verticals.

This role will report to the Head of Analytics & Data Mumbai, joining a cohort of other ambitious and enthusiastic associates, driven by ideas and with a strong proclivity towards strategic analytics. We are looking for someone willing to think beyond traditional organizational structures and with a strong desire to enhance the data and deepen the analytics.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities will include but will not be limited to the following:

> Design and develop end-to-end machine learning solutions that address key WM business opportunities and produce measurable outcomes.

> Strive to develop and experiment with State-of-the-Art algorithms.

> Partner with model risk stakeholders to validate models and meet reliability and governance expectations.

> Deploy the machine learning models in production environments, in collaboration with the MLOps team, and monitor their performance.

> Plan and conduct A/B tests to quantify incremental impact and effectiveness of ML solutions.

> Build, grow, and establish partnerships with business stakeholders as well as with our Risk, Legal, and Compliance divisions.

> Create presentations to effectively communicate model performance, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders and the broader team.

> Manage and coach associates. Experience:

> Master's or a PhD degree (preferred) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or an equivalent quantitative field.

> A minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Machine Learning (overall 10-14 years), preferably in the financial services industry

Required Skills

> Demonstrated breadth and depth in knowledge and applications of machine learning algorithms in classification, regression, recommender systems, clustering, deep learning

> Proficiency in autonomously conducting applied ML research with commercial applications.

> Proficiency in at least one of the modern programming languages (Python, C++, or a related language).

> Experience with code versioning systems such as Github, Bitbucket, and experiment tracking systems like ML FLow.

> Proficiency with computer science fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithmic design.

> Track record of working independently and solving problems creatively, as well as the ability to debug/maintain complex codes, with a strong sense of accountability and an eye for innovation

> Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner to audiences of various backgrounds/seniority; 2+ years in a client-facing position preferred

> Ability to work in a collaborative, transparent style within the team and with cross-functional stakeholders across the organization

Preferred Skills

> Experience with Cloud or Big Data technologies such as Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Hadoop, or an equivalent

> Familiarity with Deep Learning frameworks (PyTorch, Tensorflow, PyTorch - Geometric, or equivalent).

> Experience with Graphical Neural Networks, Reinforcement Learning, LLMs, Transformer based Models, or Recommender Systems is a plus.

> Track record of publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

descriptionHtml:
Life Unlimited

At Smith+Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.

We are seeking an experienced IT Director, Enterprise Integration and Architecture, to lead the strategy, design, and delivery of enterprise AI and integration solutions across a global landscape.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead the development and execution of enterprise AI and integration strategy, including AI Sandbox and advanced analytics solutions
  • Drive end-to-end architecture and design across enterprise platforms (AWS, Azure, Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake)
  • Provide architectural leadership for AI models, data pipelines, and system integrations
  • Oversee data migration strategies ensuring quality, integrity, and compliance
  • Lead Agile delivery of AI initiatives, ensuring on-time, on-budget execution with high-quality outcomes
  • Manage vendor partnerships and ensure reliable, scalable service delivery across platforms
  • Monitor operational performance, SLAs, and KPIs, driving continuous improvement
  • Engage and influence senior stakeholders across R&D, Clinical, and IT functions
  • Lead and mentor a team of architects and AI specialists, fostering innovation and accountability


What will you need to be successful?

  • 10+ years experience in software development, AI architecture, and enterprise solution delivery
  • Strong expertise in AI/ML, GenAI, MLOps/LLMOps, and enterprise integration
  • Proven experience delivering solutions in regulated industries (MedTech preferred)
  • Deep understanding of data privacy, security, and Responsible AI practices
  • Experience managing global teams, vendors, and enterprise-scale platforms
  • Strong technical background in Azure, AWS, Python, Java, and full-stack development
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills


Key Success Measures

  • Delivery and scale of AI and integration solutions
  • Achievement of IT SLAs, KPIs, and operational targets
  • On-time, on-budget delivery performance
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement
  • Optimization and simplification of application landscape


Education & Certifications

title: Assistant Vice President - Data Services (PSS08022)
descriptionHtml:
About The Company

An industry leading financial services company. The company is in a growth phase, building scalable, AI-enabled data products that power real-time insights and decision-making for enterprise clients.

Position Overview

The AVP – Data Services role leads the end-to-end product and technology roadmap for data products, driving innovation across real-time feeds, analytics, and indices. This position oversees cross-functional teams and ensures delivery excellence, platform reliability, and client satisfaction through robust engineering and product leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end product roadmap for data products spanning real-time feeds, historical data, analytics, indices, and workstations.
  • Lead a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and product managers to deliver scalable, high-quality data infrastructure and consumer-facing products.
  • Develop and deliver AI-enabled data products with full ownership of roadmap and engineering execution against committed timelines.
  • Drive technology discussions with enterprise clients, managing system integrations, SLA adherence, onboarding experience, and user feedback loops.
  • Define and enforce platform architecture standards including data normalization, latency benchmarks, redundancy, and API versioning.
  • Manage technology costs of approximately Rs. 10 crores over five years; evaluate build vs. buy decisions and optimize total cost of ownership.
  • Collaborate with the Data Partnerships team to evaluate and onboard third-party data vendors, ensuring technical compatibility and quality control.
  • Establish product analytics and usage telemetry frameworks to measure adoption, inform feature prioritization, and reduce customer churn.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Education: BE/B.Tech in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience: 10–15 years of total relevant work experience in technology and data product development.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and product managers.
  • Technical Expertise: Product engineering, data infrastructure, AI-enabled product development, system integration, and API architecture.
  • Soft Skills: Strategic, analytical, and execution-focused with strong client engagement and delivery management capabilities.


Why Consider this Opportunity?

  • Lead the technology vision for a high-impact data services portfolio.
  • Drive innovation in AI-enabled data products and analytics platforms.
  • Shape enterprise-grade architecture and influence key build vs. buy decisions.
  • Collaborate with senior stakeholders and enterprise clients on strategic technology initiatives.
  • Own significant P&L responsibility and deliver measurable business outcomes.

title: Head of Product & Growth Tech
descriptionHtml:
We're partnering with a premium consumer and hospitality company that has built a family of much-loved brands across dining, retail, and experiences. Over the last decade they have earned something rare: people came for the food, and stayed for the feeling.


As the business enters its next phase, they are looking for a senior leader to build the layer that deepens that relationship. Someone who can bring together customer data, CRM, loyalty, community, and AI, not as a set of systems, but as a way to make guests feel known, looked after, and genuinely closer to the brand.

This role reports directly to the founders. The operational foundation, the systems that run the business day to day, is already in place, held by a strong internal team. Your job is to build the growth and experience layer on top of it: the part that turns affection into a lasting, connected relationship across every brand.


What You'll Do

  • Define and drive the company's guest data, CRM, loyalty, and engagement strategy, with a view of loyalty that is about trust and belonging, not just points
  • Build a single, connected view of the guest across brands, channels, and touchpoints, without ever making the experience feel cold or transactional
  • Partner with marketing, CX, content, and business teams to deepen customer journeys, retention, and community
  • Use AI, automation, and technology thoughtfully, where it genuinely improves marketing, retention, service, and decision-making, never for its own sake
  •  Evaluate and bring in the right tools, platforms, and partnerships to support long-term growth, building on the foundation already in place
  • Sit with the founders on the bigger questions: what loyalty and community really mean for a hospitality brand, and how technology can amplify hospitality rather than replace it


What We're Looking For

  • 6 to 12 years across Product, CRM, Customer Experience, Loyalty, Growth, Martech, or Customer Data
  • A track record of building engagement, retention, loyalty, or personalisation initiatives at real scale
  • Strong grasp of CRM ecosystems, customer data, and lifecycle marketing, and the ability to turn data into relationships, not just campaigns
  • Comfortable combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and working through an existing team rather than around it
  • Experience in consumer-facing businesses: retail, hospitality, food, D2C, lifestyle, or technology platforms
  • Hands-on experience with AI-driven customer experience or growth is a plus, not a requirement
  •  Most of all: you think of customers as guests, not data points, and you care about how a brand makes people feel. That instinct matters here more than any single tool on your CV.


Why Consider This Role?

  •  A direct partnership with the founders, on something they care about deeply
  • The chance to define a brand-new capability, on top of a foundation that is already built, so you are creating, not firefighting
  • Real influence over guest experience, loyalty, community, and growth across multiple brands
  •  A rare brief: use technology to make a beloved hospitality company more connected and more loved, without losing the warmth that built it


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn or write to work@allthingstalent.in

title: Senior Product Manager - Gen AI
descriptionHtml:
Job Requirements

About the Role

The Senior Product Manager Gen AI will lead the strategic development and integration of Generative AI initiatives within the bank. This role is responsible for ensuring that GenAI projects align with the bank’s broader objectives, deliver measurable value, and reinforce the institution’s leadership in technological innovation within the Indian banking sector. The role demands a blend of technical acumen, strategic thinking, and cross-functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of Generative AI projects in alignment with the bank’s strategic goals.
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Centre of Excellence for Generative AI and other departments to ensure seamless collaboration and communication.
  • Assess project risks, anticipate challenges, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Stay updated on the latest advancements in Generative AI and fintech to maintain the bank’s competitive edge.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Establish and nurture relationships with external vendors, stakeholders, and partners in the Generative AI and fintech ecosystem.
  • Coordinate with IT and Security teams to ensure all GenAI implementations comply with the bank’s security protocols and standards.

What We Are Looking For

Education

  • Graduation: Bachelor’s degree in science (B.Sc.), Technology (B.Tech), Computer Applications (BCA), Commerce (B.Com), or Business Administration (BBA).
  • Post-Graduation: MBA or PGDM.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience, preferably in product management, AI/ML technologies, or fintech innovation.

Skills and Attributes

  • Proven experience in leading AI-driven product initiatives from concept to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of Generative AI technologies and their applications in financial services.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to assess risks, manage complex projects, and drive strategic outcomes.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership.
  • Familiarity with banking industry standards, security protocols, and regulatory compliance.

title: Head of Digital Architecture
descriptionHtml:
At Chain IQ, your ideas move fast.

Chain IQ is a global AI-driven Procurement Service Partner, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across main centers and 16 offices worldwide. We provide tailored, end-to-end procurement solutions that enable transformation, drive scalability, and deliver substantial reductions in our clients' indirect spend. Our culture is built on innovation, entrepreneurship, ownership, and impact. Here, your voice matters - bold thinking is encouraged, and action follows ambition.

We are rebuilding procurement technology and operations into a modern, AI-driven platform. This role ensures the organization evolves as a coherent, AI-native system, not a collection of disconnected solutions.

You will define how product, platform, data, security, internal systems, and client-facing services fit together, with a strong emphasis on agent-driven execution, knowledge-based intelligence, and cost-aware value add automation. Your focus is on clear system structure, consistent patterns, and long-term scalability, not on owning individual implementations.

This is a senior, hands-on role in the CTO office. You operate across Product, Platform, Data, Security, Compliance, Ops, CIO, and Professional Services, ensuring decisions align with a clear system model and that AI-driven capabilities scale reliably, safely, and economically in production.

Responsibilities

Define and maintain the target architecture across product, platform, data, AI, security, internal systems, and client integration layers.

Establish architectural principles, system boundaries, and integration patterns that guide design decisions across all teams.

Ensure system-level coherence by aligning solution architecture, platform capabilities, data structures, AI execution models, and security controls.

Arbitrate cross-domain tradeoffs, making explicit decisions where product, data, AI, security, and operational concerns intersect.

Define patterns for agent-driven systems, including orchestration loops, tool usage, delegation models, and failure handling.

Establish standards for retrieval and context assembly, combining structured data, graph relationships, and vector-based search.

Define approaches for state and memory management across workflows, platforms and agent interactions.

Guide design decisions around model integration, inference cost, runtime configuration, caching, and performance tradeoffs to ensure scalable cost-to-serve.

Define clear boundaries for human vs automated decision-making, including validation, escalation, and explainability patterns, in strong collaboration with UX

Guide the transition from services-heavy delivery to a platform-first, automation-driven operating model.

Define and standardize multi-tenant, client isolation, and integration models across internal and external systems.

Provide architectural guidance for complex initiatives and client scenarios, ensuring alignment with long-term system design.

Develop and maintain reference architectures and reusable patterns across core capabilities.

Review and challenge designs where necessary to maintain alignment with architectural principles, without becoming a delivery bottleneck.

Collaborate with the Chief of Staff to ensure architectural decisions are reflected in ways of working and efficient organizational processes.

Provide architectural guidance for complex initiatives and client scenarios, ensuring alignment with long-term system design.

Develop and maintain reference architectures and reusable patterns across core capabilities.

Review and challenge designs where necessary to maintain alignment with architectural principles, without becoming a delivery bottleneck.

Collaborate with the Chief of Staff to ensure architectural decisions are reflected in ways of working and efficient organizational processes.

What You Will Work With

End-to-end system architecture spanning:

  • Product services, APIs, and workflow engines
  • Agent-based execution and orchestration systems
  • Retrieval and context pipelines (structured, graph, vector)
  • Memory and state management for long-running workflows
  • Model integration and inference patterns, including cost/performance tradeoffs
  • Identity, access control, and security boundaries
  • Internal enterprise systems and external client environments

Event-driven and asynchronous system patterns.

Multi-tenant, client-isolated architectures.

Full-stack including omni-platform frontend and engagement channels

Human–AI interaction models and decision boundaries.

Cloud-native platforms and integration models.

Operating model design linking product, platform, and services.

Artifacts & deliverables you should expect

Target architecture definitions across all major system layers.

Architectural principles and standards guiding cross-team decisions.

Reference architectures and reusable system patterns.

System boundary definitions, service interaction models, and data flow diagrams.

Architecture decision records capturing tradeoffs, constraints, and rationale.

Guidance for scaling patterns, integration models, and extensibility.

Architectural input into major initiatives and complex client scenarios.

Requirements

Strong experience in enterprise or platform architecture across complex, distributed systems.

Proven ability to design systems that integrate application, data, workflow, and AI-driven execution layers into a coherent whole.

Proven experience in defining and driving Telemetry-based Full-Stack Observability, ensuring telemetry data can be used in real-time to continuously monitor, control and enhance our systems.

Experience with cloud-native architectures, event-driven systems, and API-first design.

Practical understanding of agent-based systems, retrieval patterns, and AI-assisted workflows.

Solid grounding in data architecture concepts, including relational, graph, and retrieval-based systems.

Familiarity with identity, access control, and secure multi-tenant design.

Ability to reason about scalability, system evolution, and cost-to-serve in AI-driven environments.

Experience working across product, CX/UX/UI, engineering, data, security, and business stakeholders.

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex architectural decisions clearly and pragmatically.

Comfort operating in an environment where systems, models, and requirements evolve rapidly.

A pragmatic mindset balancing architectural clarity with real-world delivery constraints.

How We Approach Enterprise Architecture

We define principles and boundaries, not bureaucracy.

Architecture enables teams to move faster by providing clarity, not by creating approval gates.

Decisions are made once, documented, and reused.

We prioritize coherence across the system over local optimization.

We design systems to evolve, not to be perfect upfront.

AI is treated as a core execution layer, not an isolated capability.

Why this role matters

As the platform scales, complexity increases across product, data, workflows, and integrations. Without clear architectural direction, fragmentation and inefficiency will follow.

This role ensures that the organization builds on a coherent, scalable, AI-native foundation, where agent-driven execution, retrieval-based intelligence, and human oversight work together reliably.

It ensures that our platform scales not just technically, but economically, embedding cost-aware, explainable, and reliable AI behaviour into the system architecture.

Join a truly global team.

We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. We're proud to be Great Place to Work-certified and even prouder of the people who make that possible. Let’s shape the future of procurement - together.

Chain IQ – Create. Lead. Make an impact.

title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Role description: This role is with one of our portfolio companies.


We are hiring a Lead Product Manager for one of our portfolio companies — a high-potential technology firm at a pivotal moment in its growth trajectory. This is the most senior product role within the organisation, and you will be accountable for defining the product vision, shaping the roadmap, and building the necessary discipline to take the company from early traction to significant, scalable impact.


This role offers a rare combination of high autonomy and high accountability. You will work closely with the founders, operate with lean processes, and exercise genuine ownership over product direction and outcomes.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap: Establish the product direction based on fundamental principles; translate business ambitions into a coherent roadmap with clear sequencing, trade-offs, and measurable milestones
  • AI-Native Product Development: Integrate AI meaningfully into core product workflows and user experiences from day one; this is an expectation, not an aspiration
  • Discovery & Problem Framing: Go beyond surface-level requirements; engage deeply with stakeholders to identify second and third-order problems and design solutions built for scalability
  • Enterprise & Integration Readiness: Drive API-first product thinking; understand the technical and security requirements of enterprise clients and build accordingly
  • Execution Ownership: Take full accountability from ideation through launch and iteration; the gap between strategy and delivery is yours to close

  • Act as a product evangelist within the organization, aligning stakeholders on product goals and strategies.

Non-negotiables

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; an MBA from a Tier 1 institution is preferred
  • 8–12 years of progressive product management experience, with a minimum of 3–4 years in a role carrying full product ownership and strategic accountability
  • A proven track record in building 0-1 products, owning and executing product strategy throughout the entire product lifecycle, from inception to go-to-market.
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/ML into live products; conceptual familiarity is not sufficient
  • Deep understanding of B2B or B2B2C product dynamics — the ability to serve both enterprise buyers and end users with equal clarity
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments where the playbook does not yet exist

  • A track record of building product teams and establishing PM culture in early-stage environments

title: Product Manager (AI Platform)
descriptionHtml:
Lexsi Labs is one of the leading frontier labs focusing on building aligned, interpretable, and safe Superintelligence. Most of our work involves creating new methodologies for efficient alignment, interpretability-led strategies, and foundational model research across enterprise and tabular data. Our mission is to build AI systems that are powerful, transparent, and trustworthy by design.

Our team thrives on deep technical rigor, hands-on ownership, and a strong bias toward building systems that actually work in production. At Lexsi.ai, we operate with a flat structure, fast feedback loops, and an expectation that everyone deeply understands what they ship.

As a Product Manager at Lexsi.ai, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of ML-driven platform features. This is not a coordination role. You will be responsible for problem definition, technical clarity, correctness, evaluation, and quality. You will work closely with AI Researchers, AI engineers, SDEs, and QA to ensure every feature behaves as intended, is testable effectively, and delivers real value to users.

We are explicitly looking for someone with a strong AI/ML background who has grown into product ownership, not a traditional PM learning ML on the job.

Responsibilities
  • Own product requirements and execution for AI/ML and platform-heavy features from problem definition to production rollout.
  • Translate complex AI behavior into precise, testable product specifications and acceptance criteria.
  • Work deeply with AI Researchers to collect the details of the components created and AI engineers and SDEs to ensure implementations match intended algorithms, assumptions, and constraints.
  • Define what “correct” means for each feature, including metrics, evaluation logic, edge cases, and failure modes.
  • Work with QA and testing teams to design meaningful test strategies that reflect real ML behavior, not just happy paths.
  • Break down ambiguous product roadmaps or experimental ideas into shippable, scalable product increments.
  • Prioritize features and technical debt based on user impact, system risk, and long-term platform scalability.
  • Act as the quality bar-raiser by catching conceptual gaps early and preventing flawed features from shipping.

Requirements
  • Prior experience as an ML engineer, data scientist, or research engineer.
  • Experience building developer platforms, ML tooling, or infra-heavy products.
  • Strong foundation in Deep Learning, LLMs, machine learning or data science with hands-on experience building or deploying AI systems.
  • Familiarity with testing strategies for ML systems, including offline evaluation, simulation, and monitoring.
  • Experience working closely with AI engineers on model behavior, evaluation, and performance trade-offs for multiple modalities - LLMs, Tabular, Text and Agentic systems
  • Ability to reason about ML correctness, limitations, and failure modes, not just UX or timelines.
  • Experience owning product features end-to-end, either formally as a PM or informally as a technical lead.
  • Comfortable writing precise specs, acceptance criteria, and evaluation plans that engineers and testers can execute against.
  • Strong communication skills across research, engineering, QA, and leadership without dilution of technical meaning.

Nice to Have
  • Exposure to interpretability, alignment, model observability, or AI safety work.
  • Startup experience where product ambiguity and technical depth coexist.

What Success Looks Like
  • Features ship with clear intent, correct behavior, and well-defined evaluation criteria.
  • QA and testing teams understand what they are testing and why it matters.
  • Engineering rework drops because specs capture real constraints upfront.
  • Product velocity increases without sacrificing correctness or trust.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Sia is a next-generation management consulting firm. We offer a unique blend of AI and design capabilities, augmenting traditional consulting to deliver superior value to our clients. With expertise in more than 30 sectors and services, we optimize client projects worldwide. Through our Consulting for Good approach, we strive for next-level impact by developing innovative CSR solutions for our clients, making sustainability a lever for profitable transformation.



Job Description

As a Product Manager at SIA, you will own the product lifecycle of enterprise solutions from discovery and ideation through launch and iteration. You will blend strategic vision with technical fluency to translate generative AI, analytics, and automation capabilities into measurable product outcomes for SIA and our clients. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, delivery, and business stakeholders, and communicate effectively with leaders at all levels. You will operate in Agile squads and, where required, act as the Product Owner for the squad.

Responsibilities

  • Product strategy and vision: Define and communicate product vision, value proposition, and roadmap aligned with SIA priorities, client needs, and market opportunities
  • Discovery and problem definition: Lead discovery with internal users and client stakeholders, document pain points and workflows, and translate them into clear problems to solve
  • Market and competitive analysis: Monitor AI trends and competitor offerings to identify differentiation opportunities and risks
  • Requirements and backlog ownership: Create clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and maintain a delivery ready backlog
  • Prioritization and trade-offs: Prioritize by customer value, impact, feasibility, risk, cost, and return on investment, and communicate decisions transparently
  • Cross functional leadership: Align engineering, data science, architecture, security, design, and delivery teams to drive execution without direct authority
  • AI solution delivery: Define AI feature requirements and evaluation approach, and partner with engineering and MLOps for integration, deployment readiness, monitoring, and iteration
  • Security, compliance, and responsible AI: Ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for privacy, security, and regulatory needs, and implement responsible AI guardrails such as evaluation standards, auditability, and human review where appropriate
  • Stakeholder communication: Provide clear updates on status, scope, risks, dependencies, and release plans to SIA leadership and client stakeholders
  • Metrics and optimization: Define KPIs and OKRs, measure adoption and business impact, analyze usage and performance data, and adjust roadmap based on insights
  • Launch and adoption enablement: Partner with sales, marketing, customer success, and delivery teams on release planning, training, onboarding, and adoption strategies
  • Agile execution: Lead product ceremonies such as sprint planning and backlog refinement, and partner with delivery leadership to ensure predictable outcomes and high quality

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Experience: 4 or more years in product management for enterprise or B2B software, with hands on exposure to AI enabled or data intensive products
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders in client and delivery environments is preferred
  • Certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, PMI ACP, or PMP are a plus



Skills:

  • Product management: Strong discovery, prioritization, product writing, and roadmap management skills
  • Technical fluency: Comfortable discussing system architecture, APIs, data pipelines, and technical trade-offs with engineering and data teams
  • AI literacy: Strong understanding of generative AI and machine learning concepts and practical constraints such as quality, safety, latency, and cost
  • Communication and leadership: Strong ability to influence and align technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior executives and clients
  • Analytical problem solving: Ability to use data to drive decisions and evaluate product and model performance
  • Execution: Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outcomes under tight timelines

Additional Information

Why Join Us?

  • Early responsibility: We empower our consultants to lead and deliver from the start.

  • Career development: Your personal growth is our priority, with opportunity to learn and collaborate with global teams.

  • Meaningful work: Opportunity to lead cutting-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment.

  • Inclusive culture: Be part of a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and global team.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

title: AI Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Your Role

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI-driven products and capabilities, from problem discovery and requirement definition through delivery and user adoption. Lead business requirement gathering and solution shaping by engaging with stakeholders through workshops, interviews, and working sessions.
  • Convert business problems into clear, actionable product and functional requirements, ensuring clarity, feasibility, and alignment with product objectives. Provide functional leadership to cross-functional delivery teams, including Business Analysts, developers, data scientists, and ML engineers.
  • Guide and review the outputs of Business Analysts, ensuring high-quality documentation, traceability, and alignment with business intent. Act as the central point of collaboration between business, data, and technology teams, balancing priorities, constraints, and delivery timelines.
  • Apply agile ways of working pragmatically to support incremental delivery and prioritization; formal scrum practices and ceremonies are leveraged where appropriate but not rigidly enforced. Translate AI and GenAI concepts into meaningful product features, including Large Language Model (LLM)–based solution, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches, Embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval
  • Ensure AI solutions adhere to enterprise data governance, security, and compliance standards, working closely with data and architecture teams. Contribute to product roadmap definition, release planning, dependency management, and value realization tracking. Act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, supporting decision-making through clear articulation of trade-offs, risks, and outcomes

Your Profile

  • 7+ years of experience in Product Management or Product Owner roles delivering enterprise technology solutions. Strong experience in requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design for complex business and technology initiatives. Proven leadership and coordination skills, with experience managing and influencing teams of Business Analysts and developers.
  • Practical understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, including how modern AI products are designed and delivered in production environments. Ability to work effectively across business, data, and engineering teams, translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Awareness of Data Governance principles, including data quality, access control, lineage, and responsible use of data in AI solutions. Experience working in large enterprise or consulting environments with multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
  • Should be able to define and measure the value proposition of AI and ensure AI initiatives deliver ROI value. Exposure to enterprise Generative AI platforms, AI assistants, or internal analytics products.
  • Familiarity with Agile / Scrum methodologies; certification is beneficial but not mandatory. Understanding AI ethics, model limitations, and responsible AI considerations. Experience engaging with senior leadership or CXO-level stakeholders

What You Will Love About Working Here

  • We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
  • At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
  • Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

title: Senior Product Manager(Enterprise AI Platform)
descriptionHtml:
About RapidCanvas

RapidCanvas is an enterprise GenAI platform and we help organizations move AI from pilot to production through our Context Engine, agentic AI capabilities, and a full-stack developer experience — data pipelines, workflow scheduling, API hosting, and business applications in one platform.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who combines product thinking with hands-on technical ability. You’ll own product strategy and roadmap for core platform areas, work closely with engineering throughout the build cycle, and personally prototype and build when needed — internal tools, demos, proof-of-concepts.

This role is for someone who’s equally comfortable shaping a quarterly roadmap and spinning up a working prototype to show the team what they’re envisioning.

What You’ll Do

  • Own product lifecycle from problem identification through shipping and iteration.
  • Build functional prototypes and internal apps (Python, React) to validate ideas and demonstrate product direction.
  • Collaborate directly with engineering on architecture decisions, sprint planning, and delivery.
  • Drive competitive analysis and market positioning, especially around LLM infrastructure and agentic AI.
  • Work with field teams and customers to translate real deployment feedback into product priorities.
  • Use AI tools effectively for rapid prototyping while applying your own judgment on what’s right for the customer.

What You Bring

  • 8–10 years of experience, with time spent in enterprise product environments.
  • Strong coding skills in Python (React/JavaScript a plus) — you build things, not just spec them.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM applications: Agentic coding, prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, agent patterns, or code generation.
  • Understanding of how enterprise software gets built and maintained — APIs, data pipelines, infrastructure, CI/CD.
  • Track record of working closely with engineering teams.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with AI/ML technologies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI/ML platforms or integrating LLM features into production products.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI patterns — tool use, orchestration, evaluation.
  • Experience building developer tools or internal tooling.

What We Offer

  • Direct impact on an AI platform used in production by enterprise customers.
  • A technical, low-bureaucracy team that values shipping over process.
  • Competitive compensation and growth in a rapidly scaling company.
